# Purpose

This report evaluates whether generated texts reproduce the multivariate
linguistic contrast that distinguishes authentic biomedical from authentic
general language within each language. A random forest trained on authentic
observations is evaluated on held-out authentic observations and on a target
model's biomedical output.

The primary estimand is

\[
\Delta_{\mathrm{RF}}
=
\mathrm{BA}_{\mathrm{generated}}
-
\mathrm{BA}_{\mathrm{authentic}}.
\]

A negative value indicates weaker discriminability in generated text; a
positive value indicates stronger discriminability. The independent authentic
upper bound is evaluated only in `04_upper_bound_calibration.qmd` and is
excluded from this report.

```{r mv-configuration}
chance_level <- 0.50
```

```{r mv-functions}
finite_mean <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0L) NA_real_ else mean(values)
}

finite_median <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0L) NA_real_ else median(values)
}

finite_min <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0L) NA_real_ else min(values)
}

finite_max <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0L) NA_real_ else max(values)
}

finite_sd <- function(values) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) < 2L) NA_real_ else sd(values)
}

finite_quantile <- function(values, probability) {
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  unname(quantile(
    values,
    probs = probability,
    names = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 8
  ))
}

read_rf_table <- function(path_without_extension) {
  rds_path <- paste0(path_without_extension, ".rds")
  csv_path <- paste0(path_without_extension, ".csv")

  if (file.exists(rds_path)) {
    return(as_tibble(readRDS(rds_path)))
  }
  if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
    return(read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE))
  }
  NULL
}

discover_rf_table <- function(result_root, file_stem) {
  if (!dir.exists(result_root)) {
    stop("Random-forest result root does not exist: ", result_root)
  }

  model_directories <- list.dirs(
    result_root,
    recursive = FALSE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  map_dfr(model_directories, function(model_directory) {
    result <- read_rf_table(file.path(model_directory, file_stem))
    if (is.null(result)) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    result |>
      mutate(analysis_model = basename(model_directory), .before = 1)
  })
}

normalize_rf_identifiers <- function(data) {
  if (!"generated_model_id" %in% names(data)) {
    data <- data |>
      mutate(generated_model_id = analysis_model)
  }

  data |>
    mutate(
      generated_model_id = coalesce(
        as.character(generated_model_id),
        analysis_model
      ),
      language = as.character(language)
    )
}

add_rf_model_metadata <- function(data) {
  model_id_lower <- tolower(as.character(data$generated_model_id))

  data |>
    mutate(
      condition = case_when(
        grepl("upper[_-]?bound", model_id_lower) ~ "upper bound",
        grepl("biounigram|unigram", model_id_lower) ~ "unigram",
        grepl("biogpt", model_id_lower) ~ "BioGPT",
        grepl("_completion$", model_id_lower) ~ "completion",
        grepl("_prompt$", model_id_lower) ~ "prompt",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      ),
      base_model = sub(
        "_(completion|prompt)$",
        "",
        as.character(generated_model_id)
      )
    )
}

collapse_forest_repetitions <- function(raw_results) {
  if (!"delta_bal_acc" %in% names(raw_results)) {
    raw_results <- raw_results |>
      mutate(delta_bal_acc = generated_bal_acc - real_bal_acc)
  }

  require_columns(
    raw_results,
    c(
      "analysis_model", "generated_model_id", "language", "fold",
      "real_bal_acc", "generated_bal_acc", "delta_bal_acc"
    ),
    "Primary raw RF results"
  )

  raw_results |>
    group_by(analysis_model, generated_model_id, language, fold) |>
    summarise(
      real_bal_acc = finite_mean(real_bal_acc),
      generated_bal_acc = finite_mean(generated_bal_acc),
      delta_bal_acc = finite_mean(delta_bal_acc),
      n_forest_repetitions = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    add_rf_model_metadata()
}

summarise_primary_folds <- function(
    fold_results,
    interval = descriptive_interval
) {
  tail_probability <- (1 - interval) / 2

  fold_results |>
    group_by(
      analysis_model,
      generated_model_id,
      condition,
      base_model,
      language
    ) |>
    summarise(
      n_evaluation_folds = sum(is.finite(delta_bal_acc)),
      mean_real_bal_acc = finite_mean(real_bal_acc),
      mean_generated_bal_acc = finite_mean(generated_bal_acc),
      mean_delta_bal_acc = finite_mean(delta_bal_acc),
      mean_abs_delta_bal_acc = finite_mean(abs(delta_bal_acc)),
      median_delta_bal_acc = finite_median(delta_bal_acc),
      descriptive_delta_low = finite_quantile(
        delta_bal_acc,
        tail_probability
      ),
      descriptive_delta_high = finite_quantile(
        delta_bal_acc,
        1 - tail_probability
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      authentic_baseline_established =
        is.finite(mean_real_bal_acc) & mean_real_bal_acc > chance_level,
      retention_rf = if_else(
        authentic_baseline_established,
        (mean_generated_bal_acc - chance_level) /
          (mean_real_bal_acc - chance_level),
        NA_real_
      )
    )
}
```

# Inputs and completeness

```{r mv-load-primary}
primary_folds <- discover_rf_table(
  rf_result_root,
  "rf_paired_real_generated_lang_raw"
) |>
  normalize_rf_identifiers() |>
  collapse_forest_repetitions() |>
  filter(condition != "upper bound")

if (nrow(primary_folds) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No non-upper-bound paired RF results were found below: ",
    rf_result_root
  )
}

primary_results <- summarise_primary_folds(primary_folds)
```

```{r mv-load-stability}
stability_results <- discover_rf_table(
  rf_result_root,
  "rf_paired_lang_balanced_refit_stability"
) |>
  normalize_rf_identifiers() |>
  add_rf_model_metadata() |>
  filter(condition != "upper bound")

require_columns(
  stability_results,
  c(
    "analysis_model", "generated_model_id", "language",
    "n_iterations", "n_estimable_iterations", "iteration_coverage",
    "median_delta_bal_acc", "delta_q25", "delta_q75",
    "descriptive_delta_lo", "descriptive_delta_hi",
    "delta_sign_agreement"
  ),
  "Balanced-refit stability results"
)

stability_selected <- stability_results |>
  transmute(
    analysis_model,
    generated_model_id,
    condition,
    base_model,
    language,
    stability_n_iterations = n_iterations,
    stability_n_estimable = n_estimable_iterations,
    stability_iteration_coverage = iteration_coverage,
    stability_mean_delta = mean_delta_bal_acc,
    stability_median_delta = median_delta_bal_acc,
    stability_delta_q25 = delta_q25,
    stability_delta_q75 = delta_q75,
    stability_descriptive_low = descriptive_delta_lo,
    stability_descriptive_high = descriptive_delta_hi,
    stability_direction_agreement = delta_sign_agreement
  )

combined_results <- primary_results |>
  left_join(
    stability_selected,
    by = c(
      "analysis_model",
      "generated_model_id",
      "condition",
      "base_model",
      "language"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    primary_stability_difference =
      stability_median_delta - mean_delta_bal_acc,
    absolute_primary_stability_difference =
      abs(primary_stability_difference)
  )
```

```{r mv-completeness}
expected_cells <- primary_results |>
  distinct(analysis_model, generated_model_id, language)

available_stability_cells <- stability_selected |>

missing_stability <- expected_cells |>
  anti_join(
    available_stability_cells,
    by = c("analysis_model", "generated_model_id", "language")

completeness <- tibble(
  n_models = n_distinct(primary_results$generated_model_id),
  n_languages = n_distinct(primary_results$language),
  n_primary_model_language_cells = nrow(expected_cells),
```

# Authentic reference discriminability

The generated-text contrast is interpretable only where the authentic
held-out classifier distinguishes biomedical from general language above
chance.

```{r mv-authentic-reference}
authentic_reference <- primary_results |>
  group_by(language) |>
  summarise(
    n_target_models = n_distinct(generated_model_id),
    mean_authentic_bal_acc = finite_mean(mean_real_bal_acc),
    minimum_authentic_bal_acc = finite_min(mean_real_bal_acc),
    maximum_authentic_bal_acc = finite_max(mean_real_bal_acc),
    all_above_chance = all(mean_real_bal_acc > chance_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(language)

authentic_reference_overall <- authentic_reference |>
  summarise(
    n_languages = n(),
    minimum_language_mean_authentic_bal_acc =
      finite_min(mean_authentic_bal_acc),
    maximum_language_mean_authentic_bal_acc =
      finite_max(mean_authentic_bal_acc),
    all_languages_above_chance = all(all_above_chance)
  )

authentic_reference_overall
authentic_reference
```

# Shared feature panel

The authentic-trained classifiers use the same global feature panel. This
audit checks the panel size across model and language tasks.

```{r mv-feature-audit}
feature_comparison <- discover_rf_table(
  rf_result_root,
  "rf_feature_set_comparison"
)

if (nrow(feature_comparison) > 0L) {
  require_columns(
    feature_comparison,
    c(
      "analysis_model", "language", "feature",
      "used_by_authentic_shared_rf",
      "used_by_target_model_specific_rf",
      "rf_feature_sets_differ"
    ),
    "Feature-set comparison"
  )

  feature_audit <- feature_comparison |>
    filter(analysis_model != upper_bound_model_id) |>
    mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
    group_by(analysis_model, language) |>
    summarise(
      n_authentic_shared_features =
        sum(used_by_authentic_shared_rf, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_target_specific_features =
        sum(used_by_target_model_specific_rf, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_differing_features = sum(rf_feature_sets_differ, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  feature_panel_overview <- feature_audit |>
    summarise(
      minimum_shared_features = min(n_authentic_shared_features),
      maximum_shared_features = max(n_authentic_shared_features),
      n_distinct_shared_panel_sizes =
        n_distinct(n_authentic_shared_features),
      all_analyses_use_same_panel_size =
        n_distinct_shared_panel_sizes == 1L
    )

  feature_panel_overview
} else {
  cat("No feature-panel audit files were available.")
}
```

## Prompt and completion pairs

```{r mv-paired-conditions}
paired_model_comparison <- model_summary |>
  filter(condition %in% c("completion", "prompt")) |>
  select(
    base_model,
    condition,
    mean_delta_bal_acc,
    mean_abs_delta_bal_acc
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = c(mean_delta_bal_acc, mean_abs_delta_bal_acc)
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(mean_abs_delta_bal_acc_completion),
    is.finite(mean_abs_delta_bal_acc_prompt)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    completion_advantage =
      mean_abs_delta_bal_acc_prompt -
        mean_abs_delta_bal_acc_completion,
    closer_to_authentic = case_when(
      completion_advantage > 0 ~ "completion",
      completion_advantage < 0 ~ "prompt",
      TRUE ~ "tie"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(completion_advantage))

paired_model_summary <- paired_model_comparison |>
  summarise(
    n_paired_model_families = n(),
    n_completion_closer = sum(closer_to_authentic == "completion"),
    n_prompt_closer = sum(closer_to_authentic == "prompt"),
    n_ties = sum(closer_to_authentic == "tie"),
    mean_completion_advantage = finite_mean(completion_advantage)
  )

paired_model_summary
paired_model_comparison
```

# Visual summary

```{r mv-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
heatmap_data <- combined_results |>
  mutate(model_id = generated_model_id) |>
  add_model_readable() |>
  mutate(model_readable = fct_rev(factor(model_readable)))

multivariate_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_data,
  aes(x = language, y = model_readable, fill = mean_delta_bal_acc)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4169E1",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B22222",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = expression(Delta[RF])
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Within-language change in domain discriminability",
    subtitle = "Generated minus held-out authentic balanced accuracy"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

multivariate_heatmap

ggsave(
  analysis_output_path(paths$figures, "multivariate_delta_heatmap.pdf"),

  height = 14
)
```

```{r mv-heterogeneity, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
heterogeneity_summary <- combined_results |>
  filter(condition %in% c("completion", "prompt")) |>
  group_by(
    analysis_model,
    generated_model_id,
    base_model,
    condition
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_delta = finite_mean(mean_delta_bal_acc),
    sd_delta = finite_sd(mean_delta_bal_acc),
    n_languages = sum(is.finite(mean_delta_bal_acc)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      min_rank(desc(abs(mean_delta))) <= 5L |
        min_rank(desc(sd_delta)) <= 5L,
      base_model,
      ""
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

heterogeneity_plot <- ggplot(
  heterogeneity_summary,
  aes(x = mean_delta, y = sd_delta)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 20260728,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Cross-language mean " * Delta[RF]),
    y = expression("Cross-language SD of " * Delta[RF])
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

heterogeneity_plot

ggsave(
  analysis_output_path(
    paths$figures,
    "multivariate_cross_language_heterogeneity.pdf"
  ),
  heterogeneity_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6
)
```

# Balanced-refit stability

Each stability iteration draws a balanced authentic sample, creates a fresh
authentic train/test split, estimates scaling from the training portion, fits
an authentic classifier, and evaluates matched authentic and generated data.
The resulting quantiles are descriptive subsampling ranges.

```{r mv-stability-summary}
stability_condition_summary <- combined_results |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(
    n_model_language_cells = n(),
    minimum_iteration_coverage =
      finite_min(stability_iteration_coverage),
    minimum_estimable_iterations =
      finite_min(stability_n_estimable),
    mean_primary_delta = finite_mean(mean_delta_bal_acc),
    mean_refit_median_delta = finite_mean(stability_median_delta),
    mean_abs_primary_refit_difference =
      finite_mean(absolute_primary_stability_difference),
    mean_direction_agreement =
      finite_mean(stability_direction_agreement),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_order)) |>
  arrange(condition)

stability_condition_summary
```

# Interpretation

The primary conclusions rest on whether authentic held-out balanced accuracy
is above chance and on the sign and magnitude of \(\Delta_{\mathrm{RF}}\).
Balanced-refit results describe sensitivity to sampling and refitting. An
estimate close to zero indicates similar measured discriminability but is not,
by itself, a formal equivalence result. Upper-bound recovery, the
biomedical--biomedical control, and its empirical calibration margins are
reported separately in `04_upper_bound_calibration.qmd`.
